outcome: change of mean diurnal intraocular pressure (IOP) at day 8/day 9

citations.text: IOP was measured at each time point by study staff masked to treatment using a Perkins tonometer.
The primary efficacy endpoint was mean change from baseline in mean nocturnal IOP (defined as the mean of the four nocturnal time points: 21:00, 00:00, 03:00, and 06:00 h) at day 8/day 9.
The secondary efficacy endpoints as prespecified in the statistical analysis plan were:
The mean change from baseline in mean nocturnal IOP within each treatment group was tested using one-sample t tests and 90% t-distribution confidence intervals around the mean change.
